skill.name: global-tech-stack
skill.description: Understand and adhere to the project's technology stack including Laravel, PHP, React, PostgreSQL, Pest, Tailwind CSS, and all configured tools and services. Use this skill when making architectural decisions, when choosing libraries or packages, when configuring development tools, when setting up testing frameworks, when implementing authentication, when integrating third-party services, when configuring CI/CD pipelines, when setting up local development environments, or when ensuring consistency with the established tech stack across all parts of the application.
skill.summary: Guides agents to follow the approved Laravel, React, PostgreSQL, Pest, Tailwind, and deployment tool stack.
skill.author: DevanB

content.user_title: Align Code With the Global Tech Stack
content.value_statement: Projects drift when agents choose tools outside the approved stack. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward established Laravel, React, PostgreSQL, and testing choices.
actual_capabilities: Identifies when agents should apply global technology stack guidance.
Names core technologies including Laravel, PHP, React, PostgreSQL, Pest, and Tailwind CSS.
Guides package, architecture, testing, and tooling decisions toward established project standards.
Covers Laravel-specific tools, local development, Redis caching, email, monitoring, and CI/CD topics.
Directs agents to detailed global stack standards for implementation decisions.
limitations: The detailed stack file is referenced outside the skill package and was not scanned.
It does not provide inline implementation examples or runnable commands.
It guides decisions but does not automatically enforce package versions.
It assumes the referenced project standards exist in the expected repository layout.

use_cases.title: Plan Laravel Features
use_cases.description: Use stack guidance before choosing architecture, packages, database patterns, or frontend integration for a new feature.

use_cases.title: Review Technical Choices
use_cases.description: Check whether proposed libraries, services, and test frameworks match the accepted project stack.

use_cases.title: Configure Delivery Tooling
use_cases.description: Align local setup, monitoring, caching, email, and GitHub Actions with documented project preferences.

prompt_templates.title: Check Stack Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the global-tech-stack skill to review my planned feature approach. Tell me which stack choices fit the project standards.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Project Tools
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the global-tech-stack skill to compare these tool options for this Laravel and React project. Recommend the option that best matches the approved stack.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Test Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the global-tech-stack skill to design a testing approach for this feature. Include Pest, database behavior, and frontend concerns when relevant.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Architecture Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the global-tech-stack skill to audit this architecture plan for stack drift, unsupported services, deployment risks, and missing project-standard tools.

output_examples.input: A developer asks whether to add a new email provider to a Laravel feature.
output_examples.output: The response recommends using the approved email service, explains why it fits the existing stack, and lists integration checks.

output_examples.input: A lead asks for a review of a proposed React and PostgreSQL feature plan.
output: Confirms which parts align with the documented stack.
Flags choices that may introduce unsupported tools.
Suggests stack-consistent alternatives for tests and data access.

output_examples.input: An engineer asks how to set up CI for a Laravel project.
output_examples.output: The response frames the plan around GitHub Actions, Laravel tooling, Pest tests, and project-standard quality checks.

best_practices: Use the skill before selecting packages, services, or frameworks for new work.
Pair the skill with project files and current repository context before making decisions.
Ask for explicit stack alignment notes during architecture and code review tasks.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as a substitute for reading the actual project standards.
Do not introduce new frameworks only because they are familiar or popular.
Do not assume the referenced external standards file exists in every checkout.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps AI agents keep architecture, tooling, testing, and service choices aligned with the project technology stack.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include the full stack standard?
faq.answer: No. SKILL.md points to a separate relative file for detailed stack guidance.

faq.question: Can it enforce package versions?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for decisions, but enforcement needs project configuration and review processes.

faq.question: Is it specific to Laravel projects?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is written for a stack centered on Laravel, PHP, React, PostgreSQL, Pest, and Tailwind CSS.

faq.question: What should authors fix before publishing?
faq.answer: They should package the referenced stack file or replace the parent-directory link with a vetted source.
